description_en: Updates the name, description, or content of a document or semantic model

parameters.help_zh: 类型化内容更新；对象属性按需提交，数组提交时整体替换，未传属性保持

parameters.help_zh: 仅 SEMANTIC_MODEL 支持；以完整 YAML 替换公开模型内容，与 Content 互斥

parameters.help_zh: 仅 DOCUMENT 支持；模型更新不承诺远端保存通知恰好一次
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The expected modification time. This parameter is supported only for DOCUMENT. It is required when modifying the body text and optional when modifying metadata
parameters.help_zh: 仅 DOCUMENT 支持：修改正文时必填，元数据修改时可选
parameters.name: expected_modify_time

parameters.help_en: The version number. This parameter is required when updating Content or UploadId for SEMANTIC_MODEL. Use the VersionNo returned by the Get operation. This is not an optimistic lock
parameters.help_zh: SEMANTIC_MODEL 更新 Content 或 UploadId 时必填，取 Get 的 VersionNo；不是乐观锁
parameters.name: version_no
